name: justified-gallery
title: Justified gallery
description: Photos in rows of equal height with no cropping and no gaps, the widths following each photo's own shape, laid out by CSS alone.
docs: items are { src, alt, width, height, caption }: the width and height only give the shape. rowHeight is the height the rows aim for (a number in px or any CSS length; the default grows with the window) and gap the space between photos. Every row grows its photos in proportion to their shapes until it fills the width, and the last row keeps its size. On a phone, where a row holds only two or three photos, a very wide photo that does not fit beside the one before it leaves that one alone on a row, stretched to the full width: put such a photo where it fits, or aim for a smaller row. It is flexbox only, with no layout script and no resize observer. With onSelect(index) each photo is a button for your lightbox; without it a photo is a plain figure. Captions appear on hover and, on a button, on focus, and on a touch screen on every photo wide enough to hold one (9rem).
